messages:
alex: quick passback from night shift — short summary before i sign off. primary/secondary for the next 12h: tj (primary), sam (secondary). i'm available as backup until 14:00 PDT.

alex: what happened: two noisy events overnight — a short KV-cache eviction storm in us-west (~02:10–02:35 UTC) that raised p95 token latencies, and a follow-up embeddings autoscaler oscillation affecting batch sizing for a few minutes. both resulted in transient 503s for a small subset of traffic (~0.6% of requests at peak).

oncall-bot: INCIDENT SUMMARY: #INC-2026-2115 - kv-cache-evictions — 02:08 UTC -> 02:42 UTC. pages: 3, affected: 0.6% users, severity: SEV3. linked runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/kv-eviction

maria: customer impact — saw errors mainly for long-history chat sessions (seq length > 2048) routed to older quantized shards. customer support flagged 2 customers with visible errors (ticket 4812, 4813). both notified with status update.

tj: mitigation applied overnight: increased eviction threshold temporarily (kv.eviction.target=0.82) and disabled aggressive prefix batching for the affected pool. also forced a rollout to the newer shard-scheduling policy (policy v3) which reduced queuing. latency returned to baseline ~02:38 UTC.

sam: embedding-autoscaler detail — autoscaler bounced because of a mis-estimated tail latency from a synthetic loadtest that coincided with the eviction window. scaled down incorrectly for ~4 minutes then corrected. PR to autoscaler heuristics merged: https://repo/pulls/742 (adds backoff for concurrent eviction signals).

maria: current status — all services green from SLO view; a small error budget hit was consumed for the affected route. Support update posted to customers impacted and internal RCA doc started: https://docs/redwood/ops/rca/kv-eviction-1719998888

alex: coverage notes — there is a ~3hr daylight gap for eu-east between 09:00–12:00 UTC where our primary is in apac and secondary is in NA. tj/sam please confirm handover overlap at 09:00 UTC to avoid delayed pages.

tj: noted — i'll be online 08:30–12:30 UTC. sam will take 12:30–20:30 UTC. alex backup until 14:00 PDT (20:00 UTC).

sam: runbook pointers (quick):
```
Runbook: KV Eviction (short checklist)
1) check monitoring -> /dashboards/kv-evictions
2) if evictions > 5% for >5m: scale pool + bump eviction.target to 0.85
3) if p95 token latency > 500ms: disable aggressive prefix batching: service config key `batching.prefix.enabled=false`
4) if repeated, route small-requests to fallback model variant: route-config weight 70/30
```
Link: https://redwood/runbooks/kv-eviction (bookmark this one)

maria: ops notes for next steps — embargoed auto-rollout until autoscaler PR is fully validated in canary. we should run a small synthetic to exercise new heuristics in eu-west before broad rollout. i'll schedule a 30m canary window at 10:00 UTC.

tj: action items assigned:
- tj: run canary for autoscaler heuristics in eu-west at 10:00 UTC (monitor p95, qps, evictions)
- sam: follow up with support for the two customer tickets and confirm mitigation logs attached
- alex: update postmortem outline and tag infra/reliability for kernel-level telemetry check

alex: ephemeral notes: we saw a small gap in our runbook -> the step to 'increase eviction threshold' is gated behind an internal flag that isn't obvious under stress. i'll add clearer bullets and a one-liner CLI snippet for quick ops.

sam: CLI helper (for quick ops):
```
# bump eviction threshold on cluster 'pool-a'
redwoodctl cluster update pool-a --set kv.eviction.target=0.85
# disable prefix batching
redwoodctl service update batcher-service --set batching.prefix.enabled=false
```

maria: i've added the customer impact summary to the internal RCA doc and linked the tickets. tally of pages: 3, meantime-to-detect 2m, meantime-to-mitigate 18m.

alex: closing notes: coverage is stable. primary/secondary confirmed (tj/sam). canary at 10:00 UTC — tj please ping #eng-oncall 5m before. next update if anything changes, otherwise i'll publish the short postmortem skeleton by EOD. thanks all :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Reminder: weekly on-call checklist — rotate secondary if overlap <1h.
